items.headline: Cancore Raises $7.2M at $60M Valuation on Canton
items.summary: Canton-based trading platform Cancore raised $7.2M in seed funding backed by Paper Ventures and dao5, bridging $CC network assets with public chain liquidity.

items.headline: $ZEC Co-Founder Wants to End Grants Subsidy
items.summary: Zcash co-founder Sean Bowe proposed ending automatic grants funding, pointing to a treasury now valued above $125M as $ZEC momentum builds.

items.headline: $NEAR Adds Confidential Jio Pre-IPO Trading
items.summary: $NEAR launched confidential pre-IPO trading for Jio with up to 5x leverage, set to convert into an equity perpetual after listing.

items.headline: $ONDO Brings 15 Stock Tokens to Robinhood Chain
items.summary: $ONDO deployed 15 tokenized stocks on Robinhood Chain with Uniswap pools, opening a potential weekend arbitrage route via its redemption platform.

items.headline: $HYPE Taps Kraken Parent as First CFTC HIP-3 Deployer
items.summary: Hyperliquid plans to make Kraken parent Payward the first CFTC-regulated HIP-3 deployer, a major step toward regulated US perps for $HYPE.
